tasks.description: Router assigns identical fixed scores to same-role models, causing selection to collapse to list order.
tasks.expected_fix: Add secondary scoring based on model capability so same-role models separate on merit.

tasks.description: Code assumed a fixed filename for a module that actually lived at a different path, causing null resolution.
tasks.expected_fix: Search recursively for the target symbol rather than assuming a fixed filename; fail loudly if not found.

tasks.description: Tool-decision parser rejects valid but slightly non-conforming JSON output from the model.
tasks.expected_fix: Add tolerant parsing before rejecting output as invalid.

tasks.description: A patch updated a function signature but not its call site, causing a NameError.
tasks.expected_fix: Update all call sites consistently; add a compile/import smoke test as a guard.

tasks.description: A single command silently fans out into multiple hidden model calls, inflating cost.
tasks.expected_fix: Add call-count tracing per command and cap invocations unless explicitly escalated.
